title: Multiplayer V0.99 Hosting remains side-safe through submit, reconnect and undo barrier
steps: A private multiplayer match is prepared with Host Resource and Simple Decoder in Runner grip.
Runner submits Host Resource install with an idempotency key.
Duplicate submit returns the stored receipt and stale submit is rejected.
Reconnect restores the Runner-only hosting Choice with private option labels.
Corp payloads do not contain the private program candidate before the Choice is resolved.
Runner resolves the Choice and the public event remains a hidden-info barrier.
After resolution the hosted program is openly visible in the Runner rig.
Undo targeting the hidden-zone hosting event is blocked.
